title: Shah-e-Konain Da Janaza Jado Galiyan
body:
Shah-e-Konain Da Janaza, Jado Galiyan Ch Aaya, Haye Mayyat Nay Vain Paye.
<<DIVIDER>>
Kufay Day Loko Shehr Sajalo,
Khal Meriyan Diyaan Laye,
Na Koyi Bazar Saja Ay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Meri Vairi Bahar Aajavan Utah Kay Pathar
Lain Badlay Meri Mayat Tay Vasa Kay Pathar
Koyi Shehr Da Vasi Qaidi Bankay
Meray Pour Di Bala Tay
Na Aan Kay Pathar Vasa Ay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Mera Lasha Babay Kufa Tay Lay Jah Ay Koyi
Outhou Darbar Tayein Menu Piraay Koyi
Zahra Diyaan Jayaan
Nun Galiyaanch Vich
Bin Chadar Baaj Ridawa
Na Jirkha Maar Pira Ay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Shehr Vich Jeeniya Vi Rasiyaan Nay Manga Lay Haqim
Meri Deya Di Jaga Menu Pava Lay Haqim
Bawa Gardan Day
Naal Parou Kay,
Meray Mayat Tay Haqim
Paya Neelay Daagh Banay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Teer Gardan Ch Meri Aakay Para Lou Saray
Kal Koyi Meray Putraan Nu Nah Naizay Maray
Nou Lakh Fouja Day
Ravaar Bula Kay
Vich Sehra Di Meri
Maayat Pamaal Kara Ay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Maan Baina Da Ravay Jagtay Salamat Shala
Jeevay Dooniya Tay Mera Ghazi Ay Aalma Vala
Baina Di Chadar
Paar Kay Jeevai
Ghazi Da Katil Aj
Meray Baazu Aun Lahaa Ay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Vain Karda Raiya Akbar Najaf Da Vaali
Choun Salaa Di Sakina Nun Na Maaray Koyi
Meray Kun Cheray
Maar Tamachay
Meray Bachri De Badlay
Menu Vich Qaidan Dafna Ay.
